serviceIdentification.serviceDescription:
Cloudflare operates a global network that delivers security, performance, and reliability from a single platform. Cloudflare for Government provides this same platform to U.S. Government agencies as one homogeneous stack. This Marketplace listing consolidates both of Cloudflare for Government's FedRAMP Certifications — Class C (previously FedRAMP Moderate) and Class D (previously FedRAMP High) — into a single product entry. The certified services span:

- **SASE / Zero Trust** — Zero Trust network access, secure web gateway, CASB, browser isolation, data loss prevention, email security, and cloud-delivered WAN.
- **Security** — web application firewall (WAF), DDoS protection, API security, bot management, rate limiting, and client-side security.
- **Network & Content Delivery** — CDN, authoritative DNS, load balancing, smart routing, and network interconnect.
- **Compute** — serverless functions, containers, durable objects, and workflow orchestration.
- **Storage** — object storage, SQL and key-value databases, and queues.

Federal agencies use Cloudflare to protect public-facing websites and APIs, secure workforce access to internal applications, replace legacy remote-access VPN and MPLS connectivity, and build cloud-native applications entirely within the FedRAMP-certified boundary.

The two Certifications are delivered from separate environments with separate control planes. Class C is accessed at dash.cloudflare.com and api.cloudflare.com; Class D is accessed at dash.fed.cloudflare.com and api.fed.cloudflare.com. Federal customers select the environment that matches the FedRAMP Certification required for their workload.

This offering is FedRAMP Class C and Class D Certified. The scope of the two Certifications differs by a small number of services; per-service class is denoted in the Certified Services list as follows: services with no notation are Certified at both Class C and Class D, services marked with an asterisk (*) are Certified at Class C only (not within the Class D boundary), and services marked with a dagger (†) are Certified at Class D only (not within the Class C boundary). Learn more at https://www.cloudflare.com/public-sector/
